description: This file contains utility functions for handling ZIP files, HAR files, tracing sessions, and related operations within the Playwright core server. It manages file I/O, ZIP archive manipulation, HAR file reading, and tracing session management.

classes.name: StackSession
classes.description: Represents a tracing stack session with associated files, call stacks, and writer promise.

methods.name: zip
methods.description: Creates a ZIP archive with specified entries, stacks, and sources, or repacks existing ZIP files.

methods.name: deleteStackSession
methods.description: Deletes a tracing stack session and associated temporary directory.

methods.name: harOpen
methods.description: Opens a HAR file or ZIP archive containing a HAR file and registers it for further operations.

methods.name: harLookup
methods.description: Performs a lookup in an opened HAR backend for a specific request.

methods.name: harClose
methods.description: Closes and disposes of a HAR backend.

methods.name: harUnzip
methods.description: Extracts contents from a ZIP archive containing HAR data.

methods.name: tracingStarted
methods.description: Starts a new tracing session, creating temporary directories if needed.

methods.name: traceDiscarded
methods.description: Discards a tracing session and cleans up resources.

methods.name: addStackToTracingNoReply
methods.description: Adds call stack data to active tracing sessions, optionally writing updates if sessions are live.
